title: Ink in the Well
summary: Lanternfast's well has gone black with living ink. Its water comes from the spring in the Drowned Orchard.

find_spring.text: Find what fouls Lanternfast's well. Its channel comes from the spring in the Drowned Orchard, east.
find_spring.hint: Follow the road east through the gap in the ridge.

deal.text: The Black Spring is choked with living ink, and something vast feeds in it.
deal.hint: Kill the Leech-Mother — or, if you understand the ink, burn it all clean. Brother Cale wants something else entirely.

report.text: Return to Warden Ilse in Lanternfast.

slain.text: The Leech-Mother is dead. Lanternfast's water runs grey, but drinkable.

burned.text: You burned the ink out of the spring. The water runs clear for the first time in fifty years.

choir.text: You completed the Choir's rite. Lanternfast's well sings.
